note: So nothing here sends, and nothing here goes out under my name. Each draft is written for a named human to read, change and send from their own mailbox. That is the point of the answer rather than a limitation of it: the question of whose name is on outbound is deferred, and until it is settled every word below belongs to the person who sends it.

decision.question: Does Jacob send under his own name?
decision.answer: Decide later - drafts only for now
decision.effect: Drafting is live. Sending is not, and no mailbox has been asked for. On the author: hub 23/24/25 were posted while the hub's sign-in defaulted to Zac, so it was queried with Adam. Settled as Zac's on his own answer (hub-68, 29/07) - Zac is marketing and built me, Adam is Commercial Director and owns the pipeline; whether I send under my own name is a decision about what I am allowed to do, not about a client. Adam has the reasoning and can overturn it in a line.

rules: No price appears in a draft unless it came out of a message we watched leave the building. Five of the drafts below name a figure; every one of those figures is from estimating@'s sent items. The AdminBase rows are quoted from the CRM, and the CRM has already been shown to disagree with reality, so those drafts ask what happened rather than assert a number.
No draft commits Fenster to a date, a term or a price. They ask questions.
Nothing here is signed by me. The sender's own sign-off goes on it.

drafts.why_now: The register E T & S re-issued on 24/07 moved the package return date to 27 July - a package we submitted on 17 July and have treated as closed for eleven days. If it is open, this is not a chase, it is a live tender we are not working on. It is the only draft here where a day's delay can lose the job outright.
drafts.subject: St Mary's, Merthyr Tydfil - is the glazing package still open?
drafts.body:
Tom,

We sent our price for the windows and doors at St Mary's on 17 July and had understood the package to be closed at that point.

The register you re-issued on 24 July gives a return date of 27 July for that package, which is after our submission. Before I read anything into that, two questions:

1. Is the package still open?
2. Is our 17 July submission the one you are considering, or do you need it re-submitted against the re-issued register?

If anything in the register has moved since we priced it, tell me what and we will turn a revision round quickly - our estimating team has the drawings open.
drafts.evidence: Quote issued 17/07/2026 12:17 from estimating@, GBP 174,546.37. Re-issued tender register dated 24/07 gives a 27/07 return for the glazing package. AdminBase lead 16/07, next action 17/07, never actioned.
drafts.must_not_say: Do not offer a revised price, a discount or a delivery date. If the package is open it goes back to Mary to re-price properly.
drafts.purpose: Establish whether the St Mary's glazing package is still open after the register was re-issued, and whether our 17 July submission is the one being considered.

drafts.why_now: REWRITTEN 29/07. The previous version told Bradford Watts we had quoted them the same figure twice, and that was false - it came out of a CRM row, not out of a quote. Mary has both files: April was GBP 4,252.16 for six uPVC windows over two floors, quoted 20/04/2026; July is GBP 7,975.85 for four aluminium windows and a door, ground floor only. Different scope, different system. AdminBase lead 8155 carries April's dates with July's value, because a re-quote updates the money and nothing else. Sending the old draft would have put a wrong statement about our own pricing in front of a client.
drafts.job: Unit 1 Eleanor Trade Centre, Waltham Cross
drafts.to_caveat: Mark Golden sent this enquiry to Adam himself on 14/07 at 19:44, so he is the right addressee - but he is out and his auto-reply names David Pitcher and Jay Taylor with no address for either. There is no route to them in writing: the only alternatives it gives are info@bradfordwatts.co.uk, which it limits expressly to 'an admin or payment issue', and the office on 01992 657555. So this either waits for Mark, or somebody rings that number and asks for an address. Do NOT send it to hpaxton@ - that address appears on all five 2026 rows with one phone number, which makes it the account contact for the client rather than the person asking for a price.
drafts.subject: Unit 1 Eleanor Trade Centre - our price, and what happened in April
drafts.body:
Hello Mark,

Our price for Unit 1 Eleanor Trade Centre went over yesterday afternoon and your out-of-office came back straight away, so I am re-sending it - along with our terms and conditions, which the proposal refers to and did not carry.

The price is GBP 7,975.85 for the four aluminium windows and the door to the ground floor.

One question while I have you. We priced this same unit for you in April on a different scope - six uPVC windows over both floors, at GBP 4,252.16 - and we never heard back. I am not asking you to revisit it. I would just like to know what happened, because we quote for Bradford Watts often and I would rather understand what we are getting wrong than keep sending prices into the same silence.
drafts.evidence: July: issued 28/07/2026 14:22 from estimating@, GBP 7,975.85; out-of-office received 14:23. April: quoted to Mark Golden 20/04/2026 16:23, revised 16:38, GBP 4,252.16 for six uPVC windows - Mary has the file. Both figures are ex VAT and both come from messages that left the building. The scope difference is hers too: April both floors in uPVC, July ground floor in aluminium plus a door.
drafts.must_not_say: Do not say we quoted the same job twice, and do not set the two figures side by side as though they were comparable - they are different scopes in different systems, and the client will notice faster than we will. Do not offer to re-price or to hold the figure.
drafts.blocked_on: Adam already has the re-send in hand - Mary put it to him on 28/07, routed via Pitcher or Taylor and carrying our Terms. If he has sent it, this draft is dead and should be deleted rather than sent second.
drafts.supersedes: The 28/07 version of D-2, addressed to hpaxton@ and claiming an identical April figure. Withdrawn on Mary's evidence, 29/07.
drafts.purpose: Find out whether the Eleanor Trade Centre quote is still live, and what happened to the enquiry after April.

drafts.why_now: GBP 100,730 has been with Ermine for nineteen days with nothing back, and a second Ermine job - Lower Range Road - is with Mary now against a 7 August return. One email covers both, and the second gives the first a reason to be answered.
drafts.job: Ninn Lane Re-development, and Lower Range Road
drafts.subject: Ninn Lane - where does our price sit? And Lower Range Road
drafts.body:
Tom,

We sent our price for the Ninn Lane re-development on 9 July - GBP 100,730 - and I have not heard anything back, so I wanted to check where it sits. Has your bid gone in? Is there anything on our package you want looked at again?

Separately, we have your Lower Range Road enquiry in and it is being priced now against your 7 August return. If the scope has moved since you sent it, this week is the time to tell us.

One thing worth saying plainly: we priced Lockley Crescent and Haseldine Meadows for you in January and did not win them. I would genuinely like to know why, because I would rather fix it than keep quoting.
drafts.evidence: Ninn Lane issued 09/07/2026 11:40 from estimating@, GBP 100,730.00. Lower Range Road: AdminBase lead 28/07/2026, next action 07/08, state 'quote being prepared'. Opportunity Log: Ermine 0 won, 1 lost - Lockley Crescent and Haseldine Meadows, GBP 156,328, January 2026.
drafts.must_not_say: Do not promise a return date for Lower Range Road. That is Mary's to give and she has not given it.
drafts.purpose: Ask where Fenster's Ninn Lane price sits against the others, and open the Lower Range Road enquiry alongside it.

drafts.why_now: Alexander James is the largest client in AdminBase by value - GBP 1,910,808 across six quotes - and four of them have been silent since December. Nobody at Fenster has recorded contact with them in 2026. This is the single biggest block of quoted money nobody is chasing.
drafts.job: Six open quotes - Tiverton Estate, Archway Road, Brooklands Weybridge, Weymouth Court, Darrick Wood, Emmbrook School
drafts.subject: Six windows and doors packages we have priced for you - where do they stand?
drafts.body:
Dan, Kieran,

We have six glazing packages priced and sitting open with Alexander James: Weymouth Court and Brooklands Weybridge from the start of December, Tiverton Estate and Archway Road from just before Christmas, and more recently Emmbrook School and Darrick Wood.

I am not chasing all six. I am asking one question: which of them are still live?

If some of those schemes were awarded elsewhere or shelved, say so and I will close them off our side - I would rather have an accurate list than an optimistic one. For any still running, tell me where they are and what you need from us.

If it is easier, I can come to you. A half-hour going through the list together would be worth more than six emails.
drafts.evidence: AdminBase, all six 'Live - Quoted': Tiverton Estate and Archway Road 23/12/2025, Brooklands Weybridge and Weymouth Court 05/12/2025, Emmbrook School 28/04/2026, Darrick Wood 26/05/2026. Two addresses on the same domain, which is how the CRM's two 'Alexander James' spellings were confirmed as one company.
drafts.value_source: CRM only - no figure stated in the draft, deliberately
drafts.must_not_say: No totals. Every figure for this client comes from AdminBase and AdminBase has already been shown to disagree with what was actually sent. Naming a number we cannot source would be the exact mistake this board is supposed to prevent.
drafts.purpose: Get a live-or-gone answer on six quotes open with one client, and feedback on how the prices looked.

drafts.why_now: Pride Developments has eleven quotes open, a twelfth being priced right now (Redditch Library) and a GBP 321,833 package quoted on 26 June that has never been followed up. They are one of the few clients here who are actively still sending us work, which makes the silence on the older ones worth a single call rather than a series of chases.
drafts.job: B239 Windows, and the older open quotes
drafts.subject: B239 windows - and a tidy-up of what we have open with you
drafts.body:
Roddy,

We priced the B239 windows package for you at the end of June and I have not heard where it went. Is that one still live?

While I have you - we have a number of packages open with Pride going back to last autumn, including two rounds on St Catherines House in Plymouth and the Exmoor Drive and Brandon Youth schemes. I suspect some of those are long since decided. If you can tell me which are dead I will take them off our list, and we can concentrate on the ones that are not.

Your Redditch Library enquiry is with our estimators now.
drafts.evidence: AdminBase: eleven Pride rows 'Live - Quoted', B239 Windows PD7851 quoted 26/06/2026 with a 10/07 follow-up never actioned; St Catherines House priced twice, 28/11/2025 and 18/12/2025. Redditch Library priced 28/07/2026, not yet issued - held by Mary.
drafts.value_source: CRM only - no figure stated in the draft, deliberately
drafts.must_not_say: Do not give a return date for Redditch Library. It is priced but not issued and it is still Mary's.
drafts.purpose: Get a decision on the B239 windows quote and tidy up the older open quotes with the same client.

drafts.why_now: Dan Charlesworth at A Plus asked Adam for feedback on twelve quotes on 16/07, and Adam passed it to me. Mary has now read every one of them out of estimating@'s sent items. The honest answer is uncomfortable and it is still the answer: all twelve were issued and not one has a recorded outcome anywhere. A fabricator who has priced GBP 1.48m of material on a single job is entitled to know that, and the alternative - another fortnight of silence - is how a supplier stops prioritising your enquiries.
drafts.job: Twelve A Plus quotes - feedback request
drafts.client: A Plus (aluminium fabricator - a supplier, not a customer)
drafts.to_caveat: The address is not verified by me - Dan's mail to Adam sits in a mailbox I cannot read. Check it before sending.
drafts.subject: The twelve quotes - where each of them actually sits
drafts.body:
Dan,

You asked for feedback on twelve quotes. Here it is, and I would rather give you the honest version than a tidy one.

Nine went to the client and have had no answer:

  QT50295  Brighton Longhill      issued 14/04  Etec Group
  QT42006  Colonial Way           issued 14/04  Bradford Watts
  QT50628  Emmbrook School        issued 08/05  Alexander James
  QP70107  Sharnbrook             issued 14/05  Gray & Sons
  QT50589  Favell House           issued 20/05  Fortis Vision / HCD
  QT50821  Brandon Estate         issued 15/06  Elkins Construction
  QT51271  Oldswinford Primary    issued 07/07  Reynolds Conservation
  QT51269  Ninn Lane              issued 09/07  Ermine
  QT51226  Woodland Vale          issued 22/07  Pearce Construction

Three need a sentence each:

  QT50911 Darrick Wood is live and being revised, not silent. AJ Group came back on 09/07 saying our quantities and dimensions did not comply, we agreed to revise, and your Rev1 came in on 24/07.

  QT50789 Jaques - our last quote to Jaques went out in December 2025 and yours is dated 18/05/2026. Can you tell me what that one was for? It does not match anything we have sent.

  QT42159 Spoone School - I cannot find our send under that name, but it did go out: Gintare told Vetroseal on 13/07 that the customer had come back asking whether our quotation still stood. It exists under a name we have not matched yet.

On outcomes, the honest position is that we do not have any. None of the twelve is recorded won or lost, and none of the folders has moved into our projects tree, which is normally how we would know. Brandon Estate is the one I would single out for you: ninety-odd messages on the thread, quoted to Elkins on 15 June, and nothing back since. It is not dead. It is unanswered, which is a different thing, and it is being chased by phone rather than by email.

We are fixing the recording end of this. Until it is fixed I am not going to send you hit rates I cannot evidence.
drafts.evidence: Mary, 29/07/2026, from estimating@ sent items - every issue date above is a message that left the building. Folder states from OneDrive: eleven of the twelve have a folder and all eleven are still in 1. Tender Documents, none in 2. Projects. Darrick Wood: Gleb Saliev 09/07, Adam's reply 10/07, A Plus asked 17/07, Rev1 returned 24/07. Brandon Estate: 93-message thread, quoted to Elkins 15/06, confirmed a legitimate tender by Adam on 29/07.
drafts.value_source: No figure in this draft is a price to a client. The GBP 1.48m is A Plus's own material figure on their own quote, which Dan already has.
drafts.must_not_say: Do not tell him anything was won or lost - nothing is recorded either way, and inventing a kind 'still in with a chance' is exactly what makes a supplier stop believing us. Do not promise a hit rate by a date.
drafts.blocked_on: Nothing. It answers a question Adam was asked thirteen days ago and can go as soon as he has read it.
drafts.purpose: Ask a fabricator for feedback on twelve quotes so Fenster learns why they did not convert - a supplier, so no selling.

not_drafted.what: Churchdown School Academy, Gloucester - the five bidders
not_drafted.why_not: Fenster priced this one scheme for five different main contractors: Kemdoc and Mobius Group at GBP 746,616, and Glazing Consultancy Services, Roof Estimating Services and Southern Projects at GBP 729,116. All five have been silent for eight to nine months. Five near-identical emails is how a company starts looking like a mailing list, and the useful question is not addressed to any of them individually - it is who won the main contract, which decides which one of the five is worth a call. I could not answer that from the free feeds: Contracts Finder's OCDS search endpoint ignores keyword, searchTerm, text and q, and returns the latest hundred notices whatever you ask it. It needs a different approach before this becomes an action.
not_drafted.next: Adam picks whichever of the five he knows best and asks outright who won Churchdown. One call settles five rows.

not_drafted.why_not: 212 of the 264 rows qualify as chaseable, which means the CRM closes nothing rather than that Fenster has 212 live opportunities. Drafting into that would be volume, not business development. The five above are the ones where there is a named person, a recent enough date, and a reason for them to reply.
not_drafted.next: The chase list on the board is ranked by value. Work down it, do not mail it.

corrections.was: Bradford Watts were quoted the identical figure, GBP 7,975.85, in April and again in July.
corrections.now: April was GBP 4,252.16 for six uPVC windows over both floors. July is GBP 7,975.85 for four aluminium windows and a door on the ground floor. Two different scopes, and we lost the first one.
corrections.why: The April figure was read off AdminBase lead 8155, and AdminBase updates the VALUE on a re-quote while leaving the dates and the lead number alone. The row was April's enquiry wearing July's price - which is why it matched 'to the penny'. Mary has both quote files; the CRM has one row.
corrections.cost_if_sent: A wrong statement about our own pricing, in writing, to our most frequent enquirer.
